mobile_bookmark_classic: Classic · three columns on phones, one line per link

mobile_bookmark_compact: Compact spacing · two columns on phones
mobile_bookmark_help: Classic shows three category columns below 600 CSS pixels and keeps each link on one line; long names end with an ellipsis. Single column stacks categories on phones, wraps long names and uses rows at least 44 pixels high through 768 pixels. Compact layout reduces navigation spacing on phones and tablets up to 1024 CSS pixels. From 360–599 pixels, categories read down two columns; below 360 pixels they use one column. From 600 pixels, columns adapt to available width. Desktop column and text size choices remain available. Saved category order is unchanged.
readability_help: Navigation text and application descriptions apply to the homepage, bookmarks and applications pages. Greeting size applies to the homepage. Device text scaling still applies.
category_navigation_help: Search expands matching groups. Category selection changes presentation only.
bookmark_layout_help: Each category spans the content width, with bookmarks ordered left to right. Desktop columns limits columns within categories; phone layout remains independent.
desktop_columns_help: Applies above 768px. The requested count is a maximum; fewer columns are used to keep entries readable.

source.title: Request not accepted
source.rejected: Flare did not accept this request because it could not confirm that it was sent from a page of this site. Nothing was changed.
source.invalid: Flare could not accept the address this request was sent to.
source.reason.host_invalid.message: The request Host is not a valid authority.
source.reason.host_invalid.hint: Check the Host header sent by the client or reverse proxy, and X-Forwarded-Host when a trusted proxy supplies it.
source.reason.host_not_allowed.message: The request Host is not listed in FLARE_ALLOWED_HOSTS.
source.reason.host_not_allowed.hint: Open Flare through an allowed hostname, add this hostname and port to FLARE_ALLOWED_HOSTS, or preserve the original Host header at the reverse proxy.
source.reason.forwarded_header_unsupport: The trusted proxy sent an RFC 7239 Forwarded header, which is not supported.
Remove the Forwarded header at the last proxy and send X-Forwarded-Proto and X-Forwarded-Host instead.
source.reason.forwarded_header_ambiguous: The trusted proxy sent duplicated or multi-valued forwarding headers.
Make the last proxy overwrite X-Forwarded-Proto and X-Forwarded-Host with single values and send one X-Forwarded-For header.
source.reason.forwarded_for_invalid.mess: The X-Forwarded-For chain from the trusted proxy is malformed.
source.reason.forwarded_for_invalid.hint: Ensure X-Forwarded-For holds at most 32 comma-separated IP addresses.
source.reason.forwarded_proto_invalid.me: X-Forwarded-Proto from the trusted proxy is neither http nor https.
source.reason.forwarded_proto_invalid.hi: Send X-Forwarded-Proto with the value https or http from the last proxy.
source.reason.forwarded_proto_conflict.m: The trusted proxy reported HTTP, but this instance is configured for HTTPS.
source.reason.forwarded_proto_conflict.h: Serve the public URL over HTTPS, or remove FLARE_COOKIE_SECURE and any https FLARE_EXTERNAL_URL if this deployment is intentionally HTTP-only.
source.reason.fetch_metadata_ambiguous.m: The request contains duplicate browser source metadata.
source.reason.fetch_metadata_ambiguous.h: Check the reverse proxy for duplicated Sec-Fetch-Site headers and retry from a newly opened Flare page.
source.reason.fetch_site_not_same_origin: The browser marked this write as cross-origin.
Open Flare and submit the change from the same scheme, hostname and port; do not submit management forms through an embedded or sibling site.
source.reason.header_ambiguous.message: The request contains duplicate Origin or Referer headers.
source.reason.header_ambiguous.hint: Check the reverse proxy for duplicated source headers and retry from a newly opened Flare page.
source.reason.header_opaque.message: The browser sent an opaque Origin or Referer value, so Flare cannot verify the page source.
source.reason.header_opaque.hint: Open the Flare page directly. If a proxy overrides Referrer-Policy, remove that override or use same-origin.
source.reason.header_invalid.message: The request contains an invalid Origin or Referer value.
source.reason.header_invalid.hint: Retry from a newly opened Flare page and check whether the reverse proxy rewrites browser source headers.
source.reason.header_scheme_mismatch.mes: The page was opened over HTTP, but this instance is configured for HTTPS.
source.reason.header_scheme_mismatch.hin: Open the HTTPS public URL, or disable FLARE_COOKIE_SECURE if this deployment is intentionally HTTP-only.
source.reason.header_host_mismatch.messa: The page hostname does not match the Host received by Flare.
source.reason.header_host_mismatch.hint: Configure the reverse proxy with 'proxy_set_header Host $http_host;', or set FLARE_EXTERNAL_URL to the public origin.
source.reason.header_port_mismatch.messa: The page port does not match the public port received by Flare.
source.reason.header_port_mismatch.hint: Preserve the public port in Host; for Nginx use $http_host rather than $host.

transfer.title: Import and export
transfer.intro: Export an HTML file from your browser bookmark manager, then import it into Flare. Files are processed by your local Flare server without visiting bookmarked websites.
transfer.migration_hint: Import and export each collection separately. Export both YAML files for a complete migration; accounts, passwords and system settings are excluded.
transfer.export_hint: HTML includes names, links and categories, excluding icons, descriptions, private flags and display settings. Unsafe old links are omitted. YAML preserves all bookmark fields.
transfer.flatten: Place everything in the target category
transfer.strip_root: Ignore the outermost folder (such as Bookmarks Bar)
transfer.allow_other: Allow relative URLs and other supported protocols
transfer.import_hint: Folder paths are preserved using / between levels; home applications have no categories. Duplicates are matched by URL within the target category. Updates preserve existing icons, descriptions and private flags when absent from the source. UTF-8 files only; limits: 8 MiB, 20,000 entries, 32 folder levels.
transfer.preview_hint: Previews expire after 15 minutes. Existing data is unchanged until confirmation. The selected collection is backed up before import. Preview again if existing bookmarks change.
